summary: MZ73 job 1346 failed during the first MatRIS ordinary-ML-NEB force evaluation because GPU 0 had only 20.06 MiB free when another 38 MiB allocation was requested; no complete path or AQCat25 audit was produced.

payload.objective: Run and review the complete frozen-MatRIS ordinary ML-NEB path for Fe(110) C2HO*+H* -> C2H2O*+*, followed by AQCat25 exact fixed-path audit only after a complete primary path returns.
current_evidence: Slurm job 1346 reached FAILED with Reason=NonZeroExitCode and ExitCode=1:0 after 00:02:09.
The MatRIS checkpoint initialized, but the first ordinary-ML-NEB force evaluation raised torch.OutOfMemoryError.
The traceback reports GPU 0 total memory 23.52 GiB, only 20.06 MiB free, and a failed additional allocation of 38 MiB.
No complete MatRIS path was produced and the AQCat25 exact fixed-path audit did not start.
This is an execution-resource failure, not evidence of a discontinuous path or inaccurate MatRIS forces.
payload.one_executable_step: After explicit user authorization, confirm sufficient free GPU memory and resubmit the unchanged hash-bound v9 package; do not change the checkpoint, path, or scientific settings in response to this resource-only failure.
payload.submission_boundary: No automatic retry, MatRIS fine-tuning, VASP peak-triad submission, VASP micro-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier action is authorized.
done_when: A newly authorized unchanged v9 run exits with a complete MatRIS path and AQCat25 exact-path audit, or a new truthful failure diagnosis is recorded.
The returned complete path is reviewed for ordinary-ML-NEB convergence, O-H/C-C/PBC continuity, peak structure, and dual-model comparison before any VASP proposal.
